query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `userEmpresas` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `empresaSlug` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_userEmpresas_userId` (`userId`),
  INDEX `idx_userEmpresas_slug` (`empresaSlug`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `bonificacoes` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `empresaSlug` varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `pctQuinzenalSemMeta` decimal(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `pctQuinzenalComMeta` decimal(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `pctMensalSemMeta` decimal(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `pctMensalComMeta` decimal(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
